content.title: PlayerSeasonDataset
content.description: On-disk shape of data/normalized/players/player_seasons.json. AUTHORITY NOTE: this file is a hand-maintained mirror of football_engine.data_layer.schemas.PlayerSeasonDataset/PlayerSeasonRecord for external tooling (editors, CI lint) only. Pydantic is the actual validation authority at load time; if this file and schemas.py ever disagree, schemas.py wins. Regenerate this file from PlayerSeasonDataset.model_json_schema() once pydantic is available in the authoring environment, rather than hand-editing both independently long-term.

SourceMetadata.description: If status=PLACEHOLDER: source must be null and confidence must be 0.0. Otherwise source is required.
